mapper.sql: SELECT B.BasketNo, B.CustId, B.SessonId, B.ProdCode, B.ItemCode, B.ProdQty, B.DirectOrderYn, B.ChnlCode, B.StoreCode, B.Remark, B.State, B.RegistId, B.RegistName, B.RegistDate, B.ChangeId, B.ChangeName, B.ChangeDate, P.ProdName, P.ImgUrl AS prodImg, P.ShopCode, P.ListPrice, (P.SalePrice + COALESCE(PI.OptionPrice, 0)) AS SalePrice, P.SupplyPrice, P.DeliFeeAmt, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' / ', NULLIF(PI.AttrVal1, ''), NULLIF(PI.AttrVal2, ''), NULLIF(PI.AttrVal3, ''), NULLIF(PI.AttrVal4, '')), '') AS itemName FROM shopion.tOrdBasket B LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrdProd P ON B.ProdCode = P.ProdCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrdProdItem PI ON B.ProdCode = PI.ProdCode AND B.ItemCode = PI.ItemCode
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrdProd WHERE ProdCode = #{prodCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdBasket ( ProdCode, ItemCode, ProdQty, DirectOrderYn, ChnlCode, CustId, State, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{prodCode}, #{itemCode}, #{prodQty}, '0', #{chnlCode}, #{custId}, 1, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopion.tOrdBasket WHERE BasketNo = #{basketNo} AND CustId = #{custId}
DELETE FROM shopion.tOrdBasket WHERE CustId = #{custId} AND DirectOrderYn = '0'
